description: In the left lateral cerebellar hemisphere a heterogeneous mass is present, with mixed T1 and T2 signal and only minor enhancement. DWI / ADC demonstrates profound diffusion restriction, consistent with a highly cellular tumor, most likely a SHH medulloblastoma.
